text: Meet Agnikaal: a fire calendar for our planet, built by Team AKASHA7 for NASA Space Apps 2026.

text: For twenty-five years, NASA satellites have watched fires from space. But the record is split. The newer VIIRS sensor sees far sharper pixels than the older MODIS, so the same fire can look seven times bigger. Join them, and history looks broken.
say: For twenty-five years, NASA satellites have watched fires from space. But the record is split. The newer Veers sensor sees far sharper pixels than the older Moh-diss, so the same fire can look seven times bigger. Join them, and history looks broken.

text: Agnikaal fixes this. It puts every fire on one shared grid, and calibrates the old sensor to the new one, for the exact area you choose. One consistent record, from 2001 to today.
